exec: if (pm.response.code !== 401) { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.test("可访问响应为 JSON", function () { pm.expect(json).to.be.an("object"); }); }
if (missing.length) { throw new Error("请先在环境变量中填写 username 和 password：" + missing.join(", ")); }

pm.test("响应 code 为 SUCCESS", function () { pm.expect(json.code).to.eql("SUCCESS"); });
